title: Yesterfile configuration
description: Configuration for Yesterfile's event-driven, Git-backed file history service. Omitted properties use the defaults shown here.

$schema.description: Associates this file with the Yesterfile JSON Schema so supported editors provide validation, completion, and hover documentation.

discovery_roots.description: Parent directories searched recursively for Git worktrees. Leave empty to watch only entries in repositories.

repositories.description: Explicit Git worktrees to watch, additive to discovery_roots. Use a path string normally, or an object when this repository needs setting overrides.

exclude_repositories.description: Absolute or ~-relative glob patterns for repositories that must not be watched, including repositories found below discovery_roots.

ignore_directories.description: Directory basenames excluded at any depth from Watchman triggers and snapshots. Source-repository Git ignore rules are applied separately.

store_dir.description: Directory containing private Git history stores. Null selects the operating system's local user-data directory.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum regular-file size, in MiB, retained in history. A detailed repository entry can override it.

discovery_max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth searched below each discovery root. Worktrees and known heavy directories stop traversal early.

discovery_interval_seconds.description: How often the daemon reconciles discovered repositories and saved Watchman triggers. File snapshots remain event-driven and do not wait for this interval.

path.description: An absolute path or a path beginning with ~. Environment-variable expansion is not performed.

directoryName.description: A directory basename, not a path.

path.description: The Git worktree root. Detailed entries are also explicit repositories, even when discovery_roots is empty.

ignore_directories.description: Per-repository changes applied to the global ignore_directories list. Removal is applied after addition, so remove wins if a name appears in both arrays.

add.description: Directory basenames additionally ignored only in this repository.

remove.description: Directory basenames removed from the global Yesterfile ignore list only in this repository. This does not override the repository's own .gitignore rules.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum retained regular-file size for this repository, overriding the global max_file_size_mb.
